common.name: Name
common.offline: You are offline. Showing saved data; saving is disabled.

auth.login_sub: Use the username and password the owner gave you.
auth.must_change_text: For safety, choose a new password before you start.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.low_stock_empty: All parts are above their minimum stock.
dashboard.no_jobs: No bikes in the shop right now.

parts.title: Parts
parts.opening_cost_hint: Net cost excluding GST. Leave empty to use the purchase price.
parts.adjust_hint: Use a minus sign to remove, e.g. -2
parts.import_title: Import parts from Excel or CSV
parts.import_help: Choose your Excel file. The first row must have the headings; Part Name and MRP are enough. Get the sample file to see the format.
parts.empty_text: Add your first part or import your parts list.

sample.required: Only Part Name and MRP are needed for each part. Leave a box empty when you do not know it.
sample.part_no: Part No: the number on the box. If it is empty, the app gives one (P00001, P00002 …).
sample.mrp: MRP: the selling price, with GST.
sample.rate: Purchase Rate: what you pay the supplier for one piece, without GST, before discount.
sample.discount: Discount %: the discount the supplier gives you.
sample.qty: Available Qty: pieces in the shop today. It becomes the stock when "The sheet's quantity becomes the stock" is ticked (for new parts always).
sample.min: Min Qty: below this the part shows as low stock.
sample.headings: Your own sheet works too: headings like Part No, Part Name, MRP, Rate, Qty, GST (in English or Marathi) are understood. Keep the headings in the first row.
sample.update: A part number that is already in the app is updated, not added twice.
sample.file: Save as Excel (.xlsx), .xls or .csv. Only the first sheet is read; up to 3000 parts at a time.

parts.import_auto: {{n}} new parts got an automatic part number.
parts.import_empty: No rows in this file. Put the headings in the first row and the parts below.
parts.import_read_error: Could not read this file. Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
parts.import_set_stock: The sheet's quantity becomes the stock (also for parts already in the app)
parts.import_replace: Replace the whole parts list with this sheet
parts.import_replace_note: Parts not in this sheet are deleted, or hidden with stock 0 if they were ever on a bill, purchase or job. A backup is taken first; if any row is wrong, nothing changes.
parts.import_stock_set: Stock changed for {{n}} parts (see each part's ledger: "Excel upload").
parts.import_aborted: Nothing was changed: fix the rows below and upload again.

stock.count_sub: Walk the racks in order and enter what you count. Only differences are posted.
stock.no_changes: Counted quantities match the system. Nothing to post.
stock.confirm_post: Post {{n}} differences to the stock ledger?
stock.unsaved: You have counted quantities that are not posted yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.approval_limit_hint: Request lines worth this much or more wait for owner / inventory manager approval.
settings.ca_note: Ask your CA to confirm HSN codes and GST rates before you start billing.
settings.backup_none: No backup yet. The nightly cron makes one; you can also back up now.
settings.backup_warning: The backup folder is inside a website folder. Set backup_dir to /home/<cpanel-user>/backups in config.php.
settings.gst_registered_hint: Off: plain bills without GST (BIL/…). On registration day enter the GSTIN and turn this on – tax invoices then start at INV/…/00001.
settings.upi_hint: The shop’s UPI ID from PhonePe / Google Pay / Paytm (profile → UPI ID). Bills with money due then show a scan-to-pay QR. Empty = no QR.
settings.shop_full_name_hint: Printed on bills, receipts and WhatsApp messages. The short name above is shown inside the app.

users.title: Users
users.temp_password_hint: They will be asked to change it at first login.
users.reset_password_hint: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.perm_hint: Unticked items are hidden from this person and refused by the server.

perms.see_money: See sales, dues and money totals
perms.see_costs: See purchase prices, stock value and profit
perms.make_bills: Make bills, counter sales and take payments
perms.jobs: Create jobs and estimates, approve jobs
perms.customers: See customers, phone numbers, dues and reminders
perms.edit_parts: Add / edit / import parts, adjust stock, stock count
perms.purchases: Purchase bills, suppliers and supplier payments
perms.issue_parts: Issue and approve parts requests, returns
perms.reports: Open reports (each report also needs its data permission)
perms.cash_book: Shop expenses and the end-of-day cash count
perms.change_mrp: Change a part's MRP (also while billing)

users.username_hint: Lower-case letters and numbers. If you change it, they use the new one from their next login.
users.uses_app_hint: Without a login he can still be given jobs and paid.
users.remove_hint: Someone who appears in jobs, bills or payments is only hidden, so old records keep the name. You can bring them back from Users.
users.hidden_done: Hidden – old records keep the name

errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.

errors.job_open: This bike already has an open job card.
errors.vehicle_other_customer: This bike number belongs to another customer.

errors.estimate_not_approved: Work cannot start before the customer approves the estimate.
errors.bad_transition: This status change is not allowed.
errors.link_part_first: Link this line to a catalogue part first.
errors.return_parts_first: Return the issued parts to stock first.
errors.invoice_required: Make the final bill before delivering the bike.
errors.not_your_job: This job belongs to another mechanic.

errors.duplicate_vehicle: This bike number is already registered.
errors.estimate_closed: This estimate can no longer be changed.
errors.job_closed: This job is closed or billed.
errors.return_too_much: Cannot return more than was issued.
errors.discount_owner_only: Only the owner can give a discount.
errors.credit_not_allowed: Credit is only for customers the owner marked as trusted.
errors.credit_limit_exceeded: This bill would cross the customer’s credit limit.

errors.job_not_billable: This job cannot be billed now.
errors.revision_pending: A revised estimate is waiting for the customer’s approval.

errors.no_phone: No phone number on this bill.
errors.invoice_no_too_long: Invoice number is too long; shorten the prefix in Settings.

errors.gst_mode_changed: GST registration changed since this bill. Cancel it and make a new one.
errors.edit_has_returns: This bill has returns, so it can't be edited.

errors.mechanic_has_open_jobs: This mechanic still has open jobs. Give them to another mechanic first.

fields.invalid_username: 3–30 letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore
fields.future_date: Date cannot be in the future
fields.before_last_bill: Cannot be earlier than the last bill

mobile.setup_sub: Enter your shop website address. You only do this once.
mobile.server_invalid: This address is not a Garage Manager server.
mobile.scan_hint: Point the camera at a part or rack label
mobile.camera_needed: Allow the camera to scan QR codes.
mobile.update_text: This app version is too old for the server. Get the latest app from the owner.
mobile.count_saved: Counted quantities are kept until you post them.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.name: Supplier name
suppliers.opening_hint: Amount you already owe them (negative if they owe you).
suppliers.empty_text: Add the shops and distributors you buy parts from.
suppliers.advance_note: Paying more than the balance leaves an advance with the supplier.
suppliers.gstin_hint: Optional. The state is read from the GSTIN (another state means IGST on purchases).
suppliers.delete_note: A supplier with bills, payments or an opening balance is only hidden from the lists, so its history stays.
suppliers.hidden: This supplier has bills, so it is hidden from the lists instead.

purchases.title: Purchase bills
purchases.empty_text: Enter supplier bills here; stock and costs update automatically.
purchases.grid_hint: Enter moves to the next box. Enter on the last box adds a line. Ctrl+S saves.
purchases.interstate_note: Supplier is in another state: IGST applies.
purchases.cancel_note: Its parts leave stock. Money already paid stays with the supplier as advance.
purchases.cancelled_ok: Bill cancelled. Stock taken back out.
purchases.correct_note: Change what was wrong and save. The old bill is cancelled and its payments move to this one.
purchases.mrp_hint: The MRP you enter becomes the part's selling price.
purchases.import_help: The supplier's bill as Excel: columns like Part No / Item Code, Part Name / Particulars, Qty, Rate, Disc %, GST %, MRP.
purchases.imported: {{n}} lines added from {{file}}. Check them and save.
purchases.import_new_parts: {{n}} parts are not in your list yet: they are added when you save. Check their MRP.
purchases.new_part_note: New part – added to the parts list when the bill is saved
purchases.import_nothing: No item lines found in this file. It needs columns like Item / Description, Qty and Rate.

reorder.title: Reorder list
reorder.sub: Low-stock parts and parts mechanics could not get in the last 30 days, grouped by the supplier you last bought from.
reorder.unlinked: Asked for but not in the catalogue

notify.reminders_body: {{service}} service and {{payment}} payment reminders are waiting

est.title: Estimate
est.approved_done: Thank you! The estimate is approved and work will start soon.
est.expired: This link has expired. Please call the shop.
est.superseded: A newer estimate was sent. Please open the latest link.
est.call_done: Thank you. We will call you shortly.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.lookup_hint: Type at least 3 characters. New customers are created below.
jobs.open_job_exists: Open job {{job}} already exists for this bike
jobs.empty_board: No bikes in the shop right now.
jobs.revised_needed: Work now costs more than the approved estimate. Send a revised estimate.
jobs.revision_pending: A revised estimate is waiting for the customer.
jobs.scan_done: Filled in from the photo – check everything before saving.
jobs.scan_hint: Photograph the handwritten card from straight above, whole card in view, in good light. The form fills in by itself.
jobs.approve_confirm: Approve this job? Work can start and the bill can be made.
jobs.approve_confirm_est: Approve estimate {{no}} ({{total}})? Its parts and labour go onto the bill.
jobs.part_planned: From estimate – leaves stock when billed
jobs.next_service_default: Usual gap from Settings ({{days}} days / {{km}} km). Change it if the bike needs to come sooner.
jobs.next_service_hint: Leave both empty to go back to the usual gap from Settings. Printed on the bill and used for the WhatsApp reminder.
jobs.add_part_note: Billed at its MRP; it leaves stock when the bill is final.
jobs.pick_part: Choose a part from the list
jobs.stage_completed_hint: Work done, waiting for the bill or for the customer
jobs.empty_processing: No bike is being worked on right now.

estimates.title: Estimate
estimates.empty: No estimate yet. Prepare one after inspection.

requests.title: Parts requests
requests.approval_hint: Lines worth {{limit}} or more need approval from the owner or inventory manager.

customers.title: Customers
customers.empty_text: Customers are added when you open a job card, or here.
customers.owner_only: Only the owner can change credit.

inv.no_gst_note: GST not charged – the shop is not registered under GST.

billing.title: Billing
billing.barcode: Scan or type part no. and press Enter
billing.owner_discount: Only the owner can give a discount.
billing.credit_note: Credit only for trusted customers within their limit.
billing.empty_text: Bills are made from a job card or as a counter sale.
billing.return_hint: Enter how many of each come back. Parts go back to stock – untick it for a faulty part.
billing.refund_max: Up to {{amount}} can be given back now; whatever is not given back stays as advance.
billing.no_refund: Nothing to give back: the return lowers what is due.
billing.change_mrp_note: New MRP for {{part}}. It is used on this bill and on later bills.
billing.edit_note: The bill keeps its number. Stock and payments follow the change; the old version stays in the audit log.
billing.edit_reason: Why are you changing this bill?
billing.edit_advance: {{amount}} stays with the customer as advance
billing.edit_job_qty: Parts taken off a job bill go back to stock; extra parts leave stock.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: Each reminder opens WhatsApp with the message. A customer is not listed again for 30 days (service) or the payment-reminder period.

mechanics.title: Mechanic summary
mechanics.none: No jobs billed for this mechanic.
mechanics.your_decision: Type what you pay each mechanic. The figures above help you decide.

reports.title: Reports
reports.profit_formula: Profit = sales (without GST) − cost of parts sold − mechanic payments − shop expenses
reports.gst_note: Output tax on bills minus input tax on purchase bills, by rate. Confirm with your CA before filing.

check.default_passwords: Users still on the demo password

fix.php_version: cPanel → MultiPHP Manager: choose PHP 8.1 or newer.
fix.php_extensions: Turn these on in cPanel → Select PHP Version → Extensions.
fix.db_schema: Import the files in database/migrations in phpMyAdmin, in number order.
fix.app_url_https: Set app_url to https://… in config.php and run AutoSSL.
fix.jwt_secret: Put a random jwt_secret of 32+ characters in config.php.
fix.backup_dir: In config.php set backup_dir to /home/<cpanel-user>/backups (outside public_html).
fix.last_backup: Back up now from the Backup tab and check the nightly cron job.
fix.cron_reminders_at: Add the 8 AM reminders.php cron job (see DEPLOY.md).
fix.cron_backup_at: Add the 11 PM backup.php cron job (see DEPLOY.md).
fix.shop_gstin: Enter the GSTIN on the Shop tab before the next bill – bills say “Tax Invoice” and charge GST. If the shop is not registered yet, turn off “Shop is GST-registered”.
fix.shop_address: Enter the address and phone on the Shop tab.
fix.demo_data: Remove the demo data with “Go live” below.
fix.default_passwords: Those users should change their password, or reset it from Users.
fix.live_since: Use “Go live” below when the trial is over.
fix.gst_registration: After registering, enter the GSTIN and turn on “Shop is GST-registered” (Settings → Shop). Until then bills are plain bills without GST.
fix.db_migrations: Back up, then run api/cron/migrate.php (cPanel → Terminal, or let the GitHub deploy do it).

system.golive_intro: Use this once, when the trial is over. A full backup is taken first.
system.golive_counts: {{jobs}} jobs · {{invoices}} bills · {{purchases}} purchases · {{payments}} payments · {{photos}} photos · {{movements}} stock ledger entries, plus notifications and message history. Job, estimate and bill numbers start again from 1.
system.golive_keeps: Kept: settings, users, labour rates, locations, categories and the audit log.
system.golive_parts_keep: Keep parts and today’s stock (posted as opening stock)
system.golive_parts_zero: Keep the part list, set all stock to 0 (count stock afterwards)
system.golive_parts_delete: Delete all parts (import your own list afterwards)
system.golive_contacts_demo: Remove only the demo ones ({{c}} customers, {{s}} suppliers)
system.golive_sure: This cannot be undone in the app – only by restoring the backup in phpMyAdmin.

note.inside_web: Inside a website folder (public_html) – anyone could download it

actions.user_update: User changed (role, permissions, active, password reset)

cash.title: Cash book
cash.sub: Today's cash: what should be in the drawer, and the count at closing.
cash.opening_first: first count – enter what was in the drawer this morning
cash.close_hint: Count the notes and coins in the drawer at closing time.
cash.kept: Left in the drawer for tomorrow
cash.reopen_q: Reopen this day? The count is removed so expenses can be fixed and the cash counted again.
cash.edit_categories: Change the list of expense types

bills.remove_photo_q: Remove the photo of this bill?
bills.no_photo: No photo yet. Take one of the paper bill so it is never lost.

exports.title: Excel downloads
exports.range_note: The dates above apply to bills, purchases, cash book and job cards. Customer and parts lists are as of today.
exports.workbook_hint: One sheet each: bills, items sold, purchases, cash book, job cards, customers, dues, stock, parts, GST, mechanics, profit (what you may see).
exports.sale_items_hint: Every line of every bill: part, quantity, MRP, discount, rate, amount.
exports.purchase_items_hint: Every line of the supplier bills.
exports.jobs_hint: Job cards opened in these dates, with mechanic, status and bill.
exports.cash_hint: Cash day by day, expenses, money received and paid to suppliers.
exports.customers_hint: All customers with phone numbers and their bikes.
exports.parts_hint: Same layout as the import sheet: change it in Excel and upload it back.
